notes.title: Maid Cafe Release
notes.notes:
We are happy to announce the official release date for upcoming adult game Maid Cafe... You can look forward to playing the game in full on the 25th August 2023. 

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021098/3fe6184f9887899da32c04fb0feb4f501d8f5dc5.png

Make sure you wishlist the game now to be notified on release, so that you can enjoy the biggest game we have published. Maid Games have done an amazing job with the development of this game.

https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33021098/28b5f5aa9e28f131d54905c498d548df9af977b9.png

It features almost half a million words of dialogue and scripting, over 35 characters to meet and have sexy fun with, plus over 1000 adult illustrations to unlock and enjoy, plus the chance to explore the town, buy items from shops, visit local destinations, go on dates, practice your desserts, learn new recipes and compete in a bake off competition!

Wishlist it now and don't miss out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/423640/Maid_Cafe/

Deluxe Bundles and Discounts available on release, the game also comes with trading cards and Achievements to unlock.

notes.title: Release Imminent & Patches
notes.notes:
With Club Life about to be released we felt we should inform you of some things that are available to make your game that bit better...

DLC Availability

The first item is that, Club Life includes the full original soundtrack as a piece of DLC to order, this will be available to purchase with the game on release for just $4.99.

http://store.steampowered.com//app/452900

Both the soundtrack and the game itself will also have a 10% release discount on the first week from today's imminent release.

Uncensored Patch

The steam edition of the game has been partially censored, however a simple and easy to use patch is available on the DharkerStudio.com 'Update's page of the website, with instructions on how to apply it to your steam game.

Once the patch is correctly applied, when running the game it will say 'uncensored' at the top left corner instead of 'steam' so that you know it was successful.


Thank you and we hope you enjoy the game.
